request: Check all 9 existing registered Compose service logs from exact protected registry target, metadata only. No arbitrary paths and no secrets.

bounded_host_request.command:
python3 -c 'import json,subprocess
r=json.load(open("operations/master-internal-repositories.json"))["repositories"]
for e in r:
 v=e.get("runtime_target") or {}
 if not v.get("services"):continue
 root=e["server_project_path"]
 cmd=["docker","compose","--project-directory",root,"-f",root+"/"+v["compose_file"]]
 for z in v.get("compose_overrides",[]):cmd+=["-f",z["path"]]
 for service in v["services"]:
  x=subprocess.run(cmd+["logs","--no-color","--tail","10",service],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
  print(e["repository"],service,"EXIT="+str(x.returncode),"CHARS="+str(len(x.stdout)),"STDERR="+str(len(x.stderr)))
'
